title: Fix no_feature_cross_import's _isBarrel to match the documented providers.dart crossing point (or fix the doc)

evidence.quote: The single allowed crossing point is `features/<feature>/providers.dart`, which is the deliberate, documented public surface.

static bool _isBarrel(String importedFeature, String importedPath) {
    return importedPath == '$importedFeature.dart';

test('does not recognise providers.dart as barrel', () {
        expect(_isBarrel('tracks', 'providers.dart'), isFalse);

why: docs/coding-standards.md Rule 2 and this package's own README both tell developers/agents the only sanctioned cross-feature import is `features/<feature>/providers.dart`. No such file exists anywhere in the repo (grep confirms zero `providers.dart` under lib/features/); the real, consistently-used barrel across all 15 features is `features/<feature>/<feature>.dart`, which is what `_isBarrel` actually checks and what the parallel root-Makefile audit check 15 also accepts. A contributor who follows the written standard to fix a warn-only Rule-2 violation would create `providers.dart`, and the lint (once unbricked) would still reject it — the test file even asserts this outcome explicitly (`_isBarrel('tracks', 'providers.dart')` is `isFalse`).
recommendation: Pick one source of truth and make all three artifacts agree: either rename the real convention to `providers.dart` project-wide, or update docs/coding-standards.md Rule 2 and packages/custom_lints/README.md to document `<feature>.dart` as the actual barrel. Cheapest fix: update the two docs (README.md Rule 2 section + coding-standards.md Rule 2, the latter outside this batch) to say `<feature>.dart`.
acceptance_criteria: packages/custom_lints/README.md Rule 2 section and docs/coding-standards.md Rule 2 name the same barrel filename that no_feature_cross_import.dart's _isBarrel actually accepts.
no_feature_cross_import_test.dart's barrel-name assertions match the corrected documented convention.
dart test in packages/custom_lints still passes.
